Separate exhaustive orbit construction for A5 (60) and S5 (120) reproduces orbit counts (8,17,10), (6,10,5). Each triangle has 3 distinct edge orbits, and at each successive step a selected edge is incident to one remaining triangle. Independent exhaustive free-edge collapse removes all 10 and 5 triangles; the residual respective graphs have (8,7) and (6,5) vertices/edges, each connected with zero cycles, so successive leaf collapses give a point. The independent clean-room finite enumeration confirms legality, not mere rational acyclicity. No unjustified equivariant claim for continuous graph-configuration quotient was made.
